occurrences.source_assessment: The 2012 taxonomic abstract identifies Q5-1(T) as the type strain of Intrasporangium chromatireducens; the 2009 application abstract uses Intrasporangium sp. Q5-1. The canonical NCBI descriptor is species-level even though its preferred term names Q5-1. The native correspondence follows the exact species identifier, not an experimental assembly or validated study-stock genome.
occurrences.population_scope: The chosen species-ID route reports total_genomes1 and majority_fraction1.0. A separately retained same-name strain row uses NCBI584657 and count8; it is not the selected exact-ID denominator and must not be combined with or substituted for the chosen species row. The report does not provide a support_genomes numerator for this species result. Reference counts are not experimental cells, replicates, read abundance or confirmed Q5-1 genome identity.
occurrences.name_scope: Preserve the source name, species NCBI identity, preferred Q5-1 designation and absent structured strain_designation. The Intrasporangium_A GTDB reference name is a correspondence, not a rename of the experiment or proof that the paper used a newly identified organism. Do not add study assemblies or infer them from the crosswalk.
